notes.title: Major Update, Workshop support, Critical Bugfixes
notes.content:
We are proud to finally announce a big update!

You are now able to build your own custom made levels and submit them to the Workshop!

We have written a guide on creating levels, sharing and playing userlevels. You can check it out here:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=573176138

The guide is not 100% completed yet. We will update it on a regular schedule to answer all questions that might arise while building your own levels.

Plus, the following bugs have been fixed:
- low framerate on high-end devices
- XBOX 360 controller support
- Camera display errors in some levels

Have fun playing!

notes.title: Working on an update
notes.content:
Hi guys,

sorry for the long delay, but we are finally working on an update for the game! We are currently addressing these issues:

- slow framerate on high-end PCs
- xbox 360 controller not working
- sounds still play even when turned off
- last level (5 - special 3) has display errors

we will also include a feature to play user-created levels and write a tutorial on how to create those levels :)

Stay tuned!
Jörg
